description: Skelet AF-08-ii board operator UI over the real board REST backend

compatibility.instructions: Does adding the /boards page, its contract test, and a home link change any route, envelope, migration, or dependency? New page only; backend untouched. Do existing callers keep working?

correctness.instructions: Is the UI factually wired: list/create/inspect/delete boards, save/move/remove items with workspace locator and ranks, bearer auth, shape-checked responses, failure codes surfaced, ranks rendered from persisted order? Any inert control or mock-data path?

evidence.instructions: Are the 4 contract tests sufficient: route coverage, all action markers, stable identifiers, auth without hardcoded credentials, loading/empty/failure/ordered states, persisted fields, no-mock scan, JSON bodies, native controls with labels? Typecheck/lint/build green with /boards static?

reliability.instructions: Any nondeterminism: direct REST reads per action, no caching, no timers, explicit refresh after mutations? Any stale-state trap?

scope.instructions: Anything beyond the board UI: new capture, lifecycle, surfaces, paid services, or unrelated refactors?

security.instructions: Does the UI weaken any control: bearer token in memory only, no hardcoded credentials, server authoritative on all denials, no secrets or remote code?

state.change: AF-08-ii: /boards operator console over the real board REST contracts with 4 contract tests; completes AF-08 end to end.
